summary: community.clickhouse clickhouse_user deprecates password and type_password in favor of authentication, removed in 3.0.0.
questions: How do I set a ClickHouse user password in Ansible now?

answer_card.title: clickhouse_user password options deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: In `community.clickhouse.clickhouse_user`, `password` and `type_password` are deprecated and will be removed in 3.0.0. Use the **`authentication`** option instead.
